big: A 1% yearly cost sounds tiny. On ₹10 lakh over 20 years, at 12% against 11%, the gap is about ₹16 lakh. Small each year, big over time.

lines: What is 1% extra cost? It is tiny.

The expense ratio is charged daily and is already inside the NAV. A 1% lower return for 20 years costs far more than 1% of the final amount. Direct plans cost less since they carry no distributor commission. But cost is one factor, so explain what the client gets for it.
